title: Mera hussain shariyat
body:
dono jahan roshan huwe ahmed ke noor se
<<DIVIDER>>
mera hussain shariat ki roshnayi hai
ke jis ne deen pe bahattar ki jaan lutayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeed jabr ki aaghosh ka parwanda hai
hussain haq o sadaqat ki rahnumayi hai
ke jis ne deen pe bahattar ki jaan lutayi hai
mera hussain shariat...
<<DIVIDER>>
usi ki zaat se kayenat mein ujaala hai
bajuz hussain ke tareekiyon se aayi hai
ke jis ne deen pe bahattar ki jaan lutayi hai
mera hussain shariat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bajuz bashar ke malayek falak abar roye
ali ke laal ko royi ye kul khudayi hai
ke jis ne deen pe bahattar ki jaan lutayi hai
mera hussain shariat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ataa ke baad ye hurr ne kaha ke ay maula
hussain teri tabiyat mein kibriyayi hai
ke jis ne deen pe bahattar ki jaan lutayi hai
mera hussain shariat...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek baat yaqeen se mai keh raha hoon ameer
ali wali ke malango mein be-riyayi hai
ke jis ne deen pe bahattar ki jaan lutayi hai
mera hussain shariat...
author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi
